name: media-kit
description: One-page media kit for a creator/influencer from provided facts (HTML + markdown); no invented metrics
goal: Create a one-page media kit for {creator} using only these facts: {facts}. Style: {style}. Contact line: {contact}.
constraints: Use ONLY the facts given (audience size/demographics, platforms, niches, content formats, past collaborations, rates if given). Never invent follower counts, engagement rates, demographics, brand names, testimonials or prices: where data is missing, show a clearly marked placeholder like [ADD: engagement rate] (styled visibly, e.g. highlighted). Rates section only if prices were provided, else a placeholder. Sections: header (name, tagline, platforms), about, audience, niches, formats/services, past collaborations, rates, contact. Output media_kit.html (single self-contained file: inline CSS, no external requests, printable to one A4/Letter page) and media_kit.md with the same content, plus missing_data.md listing every placeholder.
done_when: media_kit.html (self-contained, one printable page) and media_kit.md exist with all listed sections, every number/brand in them appears in the provided facts, and missing_data.md lists each [ADD: ...] placeholder used.
